evidence_boundary.official_event_scope: The Dragon Ball Official Site identifies Goku (Super Saiyan God), Videl (DB Super), Gamma 1, and Gamma 2 as the 4th Festival camaraderie characters and states that increasing camaraderie grants special rewards.
evidence_boundary.independent_name_scope: Independent Festival documentation and repository recovery records establish the four skill names and character mappings.
evidence_boundary.identifier_boundary: No exact internal identifier was recovered. An indexed name is not sufficient to manufacture a canonical ID, and absence from the current index is not proof that a skill never existed.

canonical_action: No skills.json mutation and no PQ relationship mutation.
next: Leave the four identities in the non-canonical recovery layer and move to the next substantive version/provenance or mechanics enrichment frontier. Revisit Festival IDs only when an exact structured historical artifact or canonical blob exposes them.
